Returns a woods plot for comparisons of the timepoints samples

Source: R/deuteration_woods_plots.R
woods_CI_plot.Rd

Modification of butterfly plot. x axis residues. y axis % deuteration for Peptides are compared between the sets for the significance change between sets. If there is significant change beteween sets peptides are plotted for all timepoints. Significanty different timepoints for the peptides are colored. Peptides ranges are plotted as a line at corresponding % deuteration values.

Usage

woods_CI_plot(
  thP,
  th,
  replicates = 3,
  pvalue = 0.01,
  states,
  alpha = 0.01,
  ylim = c(0, 120),
  p_adjust = "none",
  ...,
  pv_cutoff
)

Arguments

thP

output of output_tc(percent = TRUE). Raw data for procent deuteration for time courses

th

output of output_tc(). Raw data for uptake deuteration for time courses

replicates

number of replicates in sample. Default set to 3.

pvalue

p-value cutoff here set up to 0.01

states

Protein states from the set. As default all states are chosen.

alpha

critical interval, to have more restrictive use lower values, default=0.01

ylim

y axis limit

p_adjust

multiple-testing correction of the Welch p-values, passed to stats::p.adjust(): "none" (default, raw p-values) or e.g. "BH". A peptide is significant when its (adjusted) p-value is below the cutoff AND its difference exceeds the critical interval.

...

other variables

pv_cutoff

deprecated, use pvalue.

Value

Woods plots with chosen statistically different peptides

Examples

# \donttest{
file_nm<-system.file("extdata", "All_results_table.csv", package = "HDXBoxeR")
a<- output_tc(file_nm)
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 1 peptide row(s) dropped: 1 not measured in every time point, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: 3.00s=3 60.00s=3 1800.00s=3 72000.00s=3
#> no csv file written
b<-output_tc(file_nm, percent=TRUE)
#> Protein.States used: Unbound bound
#> Deut.times used: 3.00s 60.00s 1800.00s 72000.00s
#> 1 peptide row(s) dropped: 1 not measured in every time point, 0 with fewer than 2 replicate value(s)
#> Number of replicates used: 3.00s=3 60.00s=3 1800.00s=3 72000.00s=3
#> no csv file written
woods_CI_plot(thP=b, th=a, pvalue = 0.001, alpha = 0.01, replicates=3)

# }
